name: tradeping
description: MCP connector for Tradeping: signal-based leads for roofing, HVAC, real estate and mortgage with verified emails and drafted first messages.
long_description: Tradeping finds companies in the local trades that are hiring right now, the decision maker, a verified work email and a drafted three-step first message. get_account reads your plan and targeting. list_leads and get_lead read your feed. find_leads runs today's research within your plan. update_lead and rewrite_lead edit drafts; send_lead sends the next step from your own mailbox within your daily cap. list_suppressions and add_suppression manage your do-not-contact list.
